_doc: Tier-3 OOS: real venture (Speedline / Logifuture-class) — pricing optimization for shipping carriers and freight brokers. Strict OOS — venture and case constructed from public press only. This is INTENTIONALLY a vertical we have not yet tested: freight/logistics with a non-finance/non-engineering/non-marketing buyer (Director of Logistics).
_oos_provenance: Real freight-tech category; analog comps Project44 + FourKites + Convoy aftermath

venture_under_test.name: FreightLane
venture_under_test.description: FreightLane is a B2B SaaS freight-pricing optimization and carrier-management platform for mid-market 3PLs (third-party logistics providers) and freight brokers managing 100-2000 truckload shipments per month. We bundle real-time carrier rate APIs from 50+ providers, contract management, fuel-surcharge tracking, and load-board automation. Pricing: $1,200/month base + 0.5% of total freight spend managed. Target buyer: Director of Logistics, VP of Operations, and Freight Procurement Manager at mid-market 3PL firms with $20M-$500M annual freight spend. Competes with Project44, FourKites, MercuryGate, BluJay (Kuebix), and McLeod Software. Differentiation: API-first carrier rate aggregation in <2 seconds (vs competitors' batch quote requests), contract auto-renewal alerts based on carrier on-time-delivery performance scores, and zero implementation services — fully self-serve onboarding.
venture_under_test.category: B2B SaaS freight/logistics tech for 3PLs and brokers
